assertions.source: β-ensemble reframing verified (no positive excursion of E_β[ω₃] on (2,60], 60-dps, k≤16; H'(2)=Cov(ln f,ω₃)<0 all k≤19); Descartes route eliminated (sign changes grow). Surviving attack: β=2 maximises E_β[C₂] on [2,∞). No fit; no c_k.

description: Phase 3 of the covariance-kernel proof epic (qou-x631). REFRAMING: the kernel cov(k)=Σ(f^λ)³ω₃ (β=3) is one instance of the β-Plancherel (Jack) ensemble inequality E_β[C₂] ≤ C(k,2) ∀β≥2 (equality at β=2, i.e. β=2 maximises the β-biased content-spread). Boundary data: H(2)=0; H'(2)=Cov_Planch(ln f,ω₃)<0 (strict, all k≤19); H(∞)<0 (max-dimension diagram is balanced ⇒ ω₃<0); and NO positive excursion of H(β)=E_β[ω₃] on β∈(2,60] at 60-dps for all k≤16 (global sup <0). ROUTE 1 (Stein/log-covariance): PARTIAL — Cov_Planch(ln f,ω₃)<0 confirmed (Kerov CLT makes (ln f,Σ3) jointly asymp. Gaussian, Stein ⇒ sign transfer), transfer factor A/(E[f]B) positive & bounded (≈0.55–0.88) but NOT →1 (finite-k non-Gaussian), so a rigorous proof needs error control or the β-family. ROUTE (Descartes/variation-diminishing): RULED OUT — sign changes of ω₃ ordered by dimension grow with k (1→111 at k=21), bound vacuous; ties are exact conjugate pairs. NET: kernel lives in the Jack/β-ensemble literature; surviving attack = prove β=2 maximises E_β[C₂] on [2,∞). scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.
